text: Hold on, sis, I'll call you back. Hey. Building's closed. Who let you in?
delivery: first sentence into the phone, then sharper, to a stranger
style: Night guard in his twenties from Lodge Grass, Montana, Crow (Apsaalooke). Consistent rural Montana American accent throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Easy, dry, a little bored; sharp when treated as furniture. An ordinary young man, not a mystic and not a stoic.
